title: Pure Mermail
summary: Pure Mermail and Atlantean WATER combo build, integrating legacy and modern support with generic WATER Extra Deck payoffs. The deck discards Atlanteans as cost to trigger their destruction and search effects while swarming the field with Level 7 bodies for Rank 7 Xyz and Link plays.

summary.title: Starters
points: Neptabyss, the Atlantean Prince sends an Atlantean monster from Deck to GY to add an Atlantean card from Deck to hand, and revives an Atlantean if sent to the GY for a WATER monster's effect.
Mermail Abyssteus discards a WATER monster to Special Summon itself from hand, then adds a Level 4 or lower Mermail monster from Deck to hand.
Abyssrhine, the Atlantean Spirit Tributes itself and a Mermail or Atlantean to add or Special Summon a Level 7 Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua monster from the Deck.
Mermail Shadow Squad modulates your WATER monsters to Level 7, and if sent to the GY for a WATER effect, Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Mermail or Atlantean from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Mermail Abyssteus + Atlantean Dragoons
steps: Activate Mermail Abyssteus in hand, discarding Atlantean Dragoons to Special Summon Abyssteus.
Chain 1 Dragoons to search Poseidra, the Storming Atlantean or Abyssrhine, the Atlantean Spirit, and Chain 2 Abyssteus to search Neptabyss, the Atlantean Prince.
Normal Summon Neptabyss, the Atlantean Prince and send Atlantean Heavy Infantry from Deck to GY to add an Atlantean card to hand, triggering Heavy Infantry to destroy an opponent's face-up card.
Use Abyssrhine or Shadow Squad to field a second Level 7 monster.
Overlay both Level 7 monsters into Abysstrite, the Atlantean Spirit or Mermail Abyssgaios, or stack into Poseidra Abyss, the Atlantean Dragon Lord.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Poseidra Abyss, the Atlantean Dragon Lord overlays directly onto a Mermail or Atlantean Xyz Monster, detaching a material to bounce up to three cards on the field to the hand.

Mermail Abyssgaios detaches a material as a Quick Effect while you control a Level 5 or higher WATER monster to negate the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent controls with less ATK than it, and prevents Level 5 or higher monsters from attacking while it has material.
Abysstrite, the Atlantean Spirit is a Rank 7 WATER monster that revives a Level 7 or lower WATER monster and Sets an Abyss- Trap directly from the Deck.
LeVirtue Dragon is a Rank 3 that searches Virtue Stream and recycles a WATER monster from the GY.
Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer attaches an opponent's monster as material whenever a card is equipped.
Mermail Abyssalacia is a Link-2 that sends a WATER monster from Deck to GY and adds a Mermail from GY during the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Virtue Stream destroys one Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua monster you control to destroy two cards your opponent controls.
Abyss-scale of the Mizuchi negates an opponent's Spell effect that resolves on the field and gives an 800 ATK boost.
Abyss-steam draws cards equal to the number of different WATER monster Types you control, and returns a Mermail monster from GY to hand.
Abyss-sting Triaina revives a Mermail or Atlantean monster as an equipped body and shuffles three WATER monsters from GY into the Deck.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Hybrid engines like Fishborg, Marincess, and Deep Sea are omitted to maintain a focused pure Mermail-Atlantean strategy without diluting the core engine.

allow.Virtue Stream: The Trap from the 2024 Mermail set; LeVirtue Dragon searches it.
